decision.title: Technical Article Brief
decision.summary: Write a technical article only after the implementation claims, caveats, and source links can survive a reader opening the cited documentation.

claims.text: Protocol-level browser tooling exposes a concrete automation boundary that should be documented rather than implied.

evidence.excerpt: Protocol-level browser tooling exposes a concrete automation boundary that should be documented rather than implied.

contradictions.note: The protocol or runtime documentation could change before publication.

nextValidation: Re-run every command from the draft, reopen each primary source, and have a technical reviewer mark claims that need a narrower scope or a reproducible example.
limitations: This is a deterministic fixture; it is not fresh web research.
Hashes prove artifact integrity, not the truth, completeness, authorization, or freshness of a source.

integrity.note: The manifest covers exported files; receipt structure and evidence references are validated separately.
